methodology: Swept the champion model's (LightGBM) calibrated PD on validation (2014) over its empirical distribution. For each candidate PD cut-off, approved = PD <= cut-off. Picked the cut-off that maximizes TOTAL expected net value (sum of (1-PD)*interest_income - PD*loan_amnt*LGD_cash_basis across approved loans) on validation. This fixed PD value is then applied unchanged to all three models on test - each model approves test loans with its OWN calibrated PD <= this value.

standard_outstanding_principal_basis.used_for: reference only, not used in EV model

prepayment_adjusted_interest.formula: sum(total_rec_int) / sum(installment*36 - loan_amnt), train Fully Paid loans only
prepayment_adjusted_interest.interpretation: Fully paid train loans realized 82.6% of the interest a full 36-month schedule would imply, due to early payoff.

expected_net_value_formula: EV_i = (1 - PD_i) * interest_income_i - PD_i * loan_amnt_i * LGD_cash_basis
note: Chosen entirely from validation (2014) and train (2012-2013). Test (2015) has not been read anywhere in this script. This cutoff, LGD, and interest-income formula are now FIXED and will be applied identically to test with no further adjustment.
